name: The Register
patron: The yard, smallest line on the manifest and the least negotiable.
holds: One person, keeping the record of what was looked for and not found.
because: A base that only counts hits will quietly stop reporting misses, and the misses are most of the work. This is a job with no output anybody wants and it is the reason nobody repeats a search that already failed.
produces_mostly: lines that say nothing is there
study: How much duplicated effort a maintained negative register actually saves. Nobody has measured it because nobody has kept one long enough.
anchor: The file-drawer problem, addressed by paying somebody to open the drawer.
